note: Exceptions to public-rule findings. Each entry binds a code to one path and one blob id, with a reason and a date, so any edit to the file needs a new decision. Write entries with bun scripts/public-safety/check.ts --allow <code> <path>:<line> --reason <text>. Private-pack codes, identity, ref, class, size and spend-path findings are never allowlistable.
